theme: Amino acid catabolism and interconversion, sulfur and aromatic
core_role: The shared pathways are the sulfur-amino-acid branch of general amino acid breakdown, covering transsulfuration of homocysteine to cysteine, cysteine and serine catabolism, and sulfonate handling, which sit beside the aromatic, proline, threonine and glycine/glyoxylate catabolic routes.

theme: Amino acid and organic acid catabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are the generic L-amino acid metabolic and catabolic terms (plus amide catabolism) that frame this theme as broad amino acid breakdown, with glyoxylate and glycine metabolism as specific organic-acid outlets.

theme: B cell activation, germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways are the differentiation path of antigen-activated B cells with T follicular helper help, from naive and memory B cells through germinal centre B cells to immunoglobulin-secreting plasma cells, within the wider B cell identity, signalling and homeostasis programme.

theme: Embryonic heart morphogenesis and cardiac lineage specification
core_role: The shared pathways are the core cardiogenesis programme, covering secondary heart field specification and proliferation, cardiomyocyte, endocardial and septal cell differentiation, ventricle and outflow (ascending aorta) formation, which the additional terms extend to valve and endocardial cushion mesenchyme morphogenesis.

theme: Platelet activation, signalling and degranulation
core_role: The shared pathways are the platelet's internal response machinery, meaning integrin-talin-actin cytoskeletal remodelling, SNARE-mediated granule secretion and degranulation, which carries out activation triggered by the thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signals in the additional set.

theme: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and decay
core_role: The shared pathways are the mRNA-stabilising, pro-translation side of cytoplasmic mRNA turnover, with IGF2BP and CRD binding, inhibition of deadenylation-dependent decay, P-body assembly and translational activation, set against the AU-rich element destabilisers, deadenylation, decapping and decay pathways in the additional set.

theme: PAX3 and neural crest transcription factor regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are PAX3 target gene sets, which here represent a neural-crest/developmental transcription factor programme alongside AP-2 regulation and cadherin (CDH1, CDH11, CDH19) gene control and DNA-binding regulation.

theme: Renal urate transport and fructose handling
core_role: The shared pathways are urate handling by the renal SLC2A9/GLUT9 and SLC22 organic anion transporters and its loss in hereditary hypouricemia, which this theme ties to fructose transport and intestinal hexose absorption through the dual urate/fructose transporter GLUT9 and fructose-driven urate production.

theme: Regulation of kidney development and nephron growth
core_role: The shared pathways are the controls on kidney size and growth, setting the balance of nephron progenitor mesenchyme maintenance, proliferation and apoptosis, which feed the metanephric tubule, loop of Henle and collecting duct formation in the additional set.

theme: RNA polymerase II initiation and elongation, including HIV transcription
core_role: The shared pathways are the host Pol II promoter-proximal steps, covering pre-transcription events, CTD phosphorylation and capping enzyme recruitment, pausing and early elongation complex formation, which HIV-1 Tat hijacks to overcome abortive elongation of the viral transcript.

theme: Dolichol-linked N-glycan and GPI anchor synthesis, CDG disorders
core_role: The shared pathways are the sugar-donor and lipid-carrier supply for ER glycosylation, with UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucose and dolichyl-phosphate synthesis and early lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly, framed through the congenital disorders of glycosylation and myasthenic syndromes their defects cause.

theme: Chromatin remodelling at DNA double-strand break repair
core_role: The shared pathways are chromatin-level events, meaning nucleosome reorganisation, protein recruitment to chromatin, and ADP-ribosylation regulation, that make DNA double-strand breaks accessible to and signal for homologous recombination and NHEJ repair.

theme: HDL biogenesis and reverse cholesterol transport
core_role: The shared pathways are ABCA1/apoA-I-driven cholesterol efflux and nascent HDL assembly (and its loss in Tangier disease), the first step of reverse cholesterol transport, which the additional terms extend to LXR-regulated efflux, lipoprotein remodelling and foam-cell restraint.

theme: RNA processing, surveillance and decay
core_role: The shared pathways are the quality-control and turnover end of RNA metabolism, with nonsense-, non-stop- and no-go mRNA decay, stalled-ribosome rescue and nascent-peptide degradation, translation termination, and rRNA, tRNA and pre-mRNA catabolism, set against the nuclear splicing, 3'-end processing, snRNA biogenesis and export machinery in the additional set.

theme: Protein and lipid glycosylation and glycosylation disorders
core_role: The shared pathways are Golgi glycan elaboration on N- and O-glycoproteins and glycolipids, meaning nucleotide-sugar transport, fucosylation, sialylation, blood-group (ABO, Lewis) antigen and selectin-ligand synthesis, and their congenital defects, which this theme places beside proteoglycan GAG chain synthesis and O-mannosyl dystroglycan glycosylation.

theme: ER protein targeting, quality control and export
core_role: The shared pathways are ER quality control after entry, meaning mannose trimming, ER retention, retrotranslocation for degradation and controlled ER exit, following the SRP-dependent and tail-anchored targeting and insertion of proteins into the ER in the additional set.

theme: Nucleic acid editing, deamination and demethylation
core_role: The shared pathways are APOBEC cytidine deamination used as antiviral restriction, with C-to-U editing of foreign nucleic acids, suppression of viral (retroviral) replication, and its counteraction by HIV Vif, within a broader set of base-modifying enzymes for A-to-I editing, DNA demethylation and alkylation damage reversal.

theme: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and early embryonic development
core_role: The shared pathways are the oocyte-to-embryo handover, covering clearance of maternal mRNAs, zygotic genome activation, epigenetic reprogramming of the pronuclei, cleavage, and the first lineage decisions (pluripotency, trophectoderm, primordial germ cells), which lead into inner cell mass and implantation events.

theme: Protein lysine and arginine methylation
core_role: The shared pathways are protein methyltransferase activity on lysine and arginine residues (including TP53 methylation) linked to methionine sensing, which this theme connects to ribosome biogenesis and cap-dependent translation initiation.

theme: Oncogene-induced cellular senescence
core_role: The shared pathways are the induction of senescence by oncogenic stress and the block on re-entry into the cell cycle from quiescence, which the additional terms complete with senescence-associated heterochromatin formation and its negative regulation.

theme: Innate cytosolic DNA sensing and dendritic cell cytokines
core_role: The shared pathways are cGAS-STING activation, including cGAMP import, driving myeloid dendritic cell cytokine production, framed here as innate host defence alongside inflammasome, GBP, chemokine (CCL5) and anti-protozoan responses.

theme: IFN-gamma, IL-12 and Th1-driven antigen presentation
core_role: The shared pathways are IL-12/JAK-STAT signalling and T cell antigen presentation with MHC class II regulation, framed as the Th1 axis in which IL-12 drives IFN-gamma, which in turn controls MHC expression, cytotoxic T cell expansion and allograft-type responses.

theme: Proline, ornithine and arginine metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are glutamine-family amino acid metabolism, meaning proline synthesis and catabolism and citrulline metabolism, linked through ornithine to arginine catabolism, urea cycle regulation and cationic amino acid transport defects.

theme: DNA topology and repair at replication forks
core_role: The shared pathways are DNA structural transactions during genome maintenance, covering topological and geometric change, fork reversal, R-loop processing, protein-DNA complex removal and repair pathway choice, which are coordinated by the PARP-mediated ADP-ribosylation and chromatin remodelling at damage sites in the additional set.

theme: Telomere maintenance and recombination-based DNA repair
core_role: The shared pathways are telomere-specific DNA transactions, covering capping and protection from NHEJ, D-loop and t-circle handling, recombination-based (ALT) and replication-based telomere maintenance, and break-induced replication, set within homologous recombination and replication-stress repair.

theme: Actin cytoskeleton remodelling and cell shape
core_role: The shared pathways are signalling control of actin protrusions, with filopodium assembly, RHOF and EPHB signalling, cell-polarity-driven shape and postsynaptic actin, which act on actin bundling, crosslinking and integrin/focal adhesion machinery.

theme: One-carbon, folate and nucleotide metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are the folate and methionine cycles, covering tetrahydrofolate interconversion, formate and 10-formyl-THF, SAM and methionine salvage (and their defects), the one-carbon supply that feeds de novo purine and thymidylate synthesis within the nucleotide metabolism of the additional set.

theme: Axon regeneration and growth control
core_role: The shared pathways are axon regrowth after injury and its positive and negative regulation, which the additional terms explain through growth-stimulating and RHOA/ceramide-mediated growth-inhibitory neuronal signalling.

theme: Blood coagulation, von Willebrand factor and fibrinolysis
core_role: The shared pathways are the primary hemostasis step, VWF binding to collagen and platelet GPIb with ADAMTS13 cleavage and their variants, framed as part of coagulation alongside the factor VIII/IX/V cascade defects, contact activation and fibrin formation and dissolution.

theme: Pancreatic progenitor lineage and endocrine differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways are the transcriptional lineage programme of early multipotent and endocrine-progenitor pancreatic cells, including transdifferentiation, which lead into NEUROG3-driven endocrine (alpha cell) and exocrine differentiation.

theme: Erythrocyte gas and ammonium transport
core_role: The shared pathways are red cell membrane transport of oxygen, carbon dioxide, nitric oxide and ammonium, including the Rh-associated glycoproteins and Rh-null disease, which link to carbonic anhydrase, ammonium homeostasis and basigin-chaperoned monocarboxylate transport.

theme: p53 regulation by phosphorylation and ubiquitin degradation
core_role: The shared pathways are the DNA-damage control of TP53 and checkpoint proteins, covering phosphorylation-driven p53 activation, MDM2/COP1-mediated p53 degradation and Cdc25A destruction, with p53-driven repair gene transcription, regulated by the kinase/phosphatase steps in the additional set.

theme: Mitochondrial RNA processing and translation
core_role: The shared pathways are mitochondrial mRNA and rRNA fate, meaning mRNA stability and modification, FASTK-mediated processing, rRNA modification and mitoribosome assembly that enable mitochondrial translation, complemented by mitochondrial tRNA processing and modification.

theme: Mitochondrial tRNA processing and RNA pseudouridylation
core_role: The shared pathways are mitochondrial tRNA maturation, covering 3'-end processing and base modification, framed as part of RNA modification chemistry together with pseudouridine synthesis on tRNA, mRNA and rRNA.

theme: RNA modification and ribosome biogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways are the mitochondrial branch of RNA modification and ribosome assembly, with mito-mRNA and rRNA modification, mitoribosome subunit assembly and translation, paralleled by cytosolic/nucleolar rRNA, tRNA and snRNA methylation and pseudouridylation.

theme: Cellular calcium signalling and homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways are calcium entry and intracellular calcium signalling, with voltage-gated channel activation, caffeine-triggered store release and calcium sequestration, balanced by sodium/calcium exchange and cytosolic calcium clearance.

theme: Monocyte/macrophage inflammatory activation and recruitment
core_role: The shared pathways are monocyte activation and proinflammatory cytokine/chemokine (MCP-1) output and its restraint, set within monocyte chemotaxis, extravasation, RAGE and scavenger receptor sensing and p38 signalling.

theme: Axial mesoderm formation and convergent extension
core_role: The shared pathways are notochord and axial mesoderm morphogenesis with apical constriction and Wnt/DVL regulation, the body-axis tissue shaped by planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension and patterned by Hedgehog signalling.

theme: Somitogenesis and segmentation clock
core_role: The shared pathways are somite segmentation and compartment patterning, including the LFNG/Notch segmentation clock whose defect causes spondylocostal dysostosis, extended by somite specification, rostrocaudal polarity and axis elongation.

theme: Germ cell and gonad development
core_role: The shared pathways are germ cell migration, proliferation, survival and meiotic entry together with gonadal somatic signals (Leydig cell differentiation, AMH and activin), within primordial germ cell specification and testis determination.

theme: Muscle growth, hypertrophy and adaptation
core_role: The shared pathways are cardiomyocyte size control and adaptive hypertrophy, including sarcomere organisation, presented as part of striated muscle remodelling together with skeletal muscle atrophy, regeneration, activity responses and fibre-type switching.

theme: Cytoplasmic mRNA translation and translational quality control
core_role: The shared pathways are the end of translation and its surveillance, with termination, nonsense-mediated, non-stop and no-go decay and eEF2 diphthamide modification, complemented by initiation, elongation and ribosome rescue in the additional set.

theme: Nitrogen metabolism, glutamate/aspartate and the urea cycle
core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate, glutamine and aspartate metabolism and nitrogen utilisation, framed as the supply of ammonia and aspartate nitrogen into the urea cycle, whose enzyme and transporter defects make up the additional set.

theme: Bacterial toxins and pathogen-host interaction
core_role: The shared pathways are host responses to microbial products, covering diphtheria and anthrax toxin uptake, NADPH oxidase activation, anti-inflammatory CD163 and pathogen-specific responses, set beside bacterial attachment and entry into host cells.

theme: B lymphocyte identity and activation
core_role: The shared pathways are B cell receptor signalling and B-lymphocyte transcriptional modules framed as lymphoid activation, set within the broader naive, memory and plasma cell B cell surface signatures.

theme: Cilium and centriole biogenesis and function
core_role: The shared pathways are the centriole/basal body machinery that nucleates and anchors cilia and controls cilium assembly and disassembly, the base for ciliary transport, motile cilia, sperm flagella and brain ventricle development.

theme: Endosomal and Golgi membrane trafficking
core_role: The shared pathways are Rab-regulated endocytic recycling and endosome-to-plasma membrane traffic, framed within the Golgi-endosome-lysosome trafficking network, which also covers retrograde transport and secretion.

theme: Chromatin assembly and SWI/SNF remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways are nucleosome assembly and protein recruitment to chromatin during replication, set beside the assembly of BAF and CHD chromatin remodelling complexes and their roles in stem cell maintenance and DNA repair.
